content.value_statement: Mobile teams often lack a clear process for improving app discovery and store conversion. This skill produces prioritized metadata, keyword, testing, localization, review, and launch recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Scores keywords using supplied volume, competition, relevance, and ranking inputs.
Optimizes Apple and Google metadata while validating platform character limits.
Compares supplied competitor listings to identify keyword, rating, and content gaps.
Calculates an ASO health score from metadata, ratings, keyword performance, and conversion data.
Plans A/B tests, estimates sample sizes, tracks results, and summarizes statistical outcomes.
Analyzes supplied reviews, localization opportunities, and launch requirements to produce prioritized actions.
limitations: Does not fetch live App Store or Google Play data; users must provide current inputs.
Search volume, revenue, market, and ROI outputs are directional estimates rather than verified platform data.
Generated translations require native-speaker review before publication.
Store policies and algorithms change, so current requirements must be verified before release.

use_cases.title: Improve an Indie App Listing
use_cases.description: Audit supplied keywords and metadata, then prioritize changes that can improve organic discovery and conversion.

use_cases.title: Manage a Mobile Growth Program
use_cases.description: Compare listings, review trends, and experiments across releases to guide an evidence-based ASO roadmap.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Store Launch
use_cases.description: Create platform checklists, localized metadata plans, and launch timing recommendations before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [platform] listing for [app name]. Check character limits, clarity, keyword placement, and conversion messaging, then prioritize five improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Target Keywords
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these candidate keywords using the supplied volume, competition, relevance, and ranking data. Recommend primary, secondary, and long-tail targets with reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitors and Reviews
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our listing with these competitor listings and analyze the supplied reviews. Identify keyword gaps, recurring issues, feature requests, and three strategic opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Build an ASO Experiment Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Using our metadata, ratings, conversion metrics, keyword rankings, and traffic, calculate an ASO score. Design two prioritized A/B tests with sample requirements and decision rules.

output_examples.input: Apple listing for FocusFlow with a 34-character title and three supplied priority keywords.
output: Title issue: the current title exceeds Apple's stated 30-character limit.
Priority: test the shorter title before revising secondary metadata.

output_examples.input: Two hundred supplied reviews for a fitness app, including ratings and dates.
output: Sentiment trend: negative feedback is concentrated in recent sync failures.
Recommended action: address sync reliability before promoting new features.

output_examples.input: Icon test with baseline conversion, expected lift, daily traffic, and significance target.
output: Primary metric: store listing conversion rate.
Run both variants concurrently until the planned sample is reached.
Adopt the variant only when the defined significance and minimum lift thresholds are met.

best_practices: Provide current, platform-specific data and identify which metrics are measured or estimated.
Review generated metadata for factual accuracy, brand voice, and current store requirements.
Change one major test variable at a time and define success criteria before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated search volume or ROI as verified platform data.
Do not copy competitor keywords without confirming relevance to actual app features.
Do not publish generated translations without native-speaker and policy review.

faq.question: Does this skill collect live store data?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes data you provide and can reference optional external research resources.

faq.question: Which stores are supported?
faq.answer: The workflows cover Apple App Store and Google Play metadata, scoring, testing, localization, reviews, and launch planning.

faq.question: Can it guarantee higher rankings?
faq.answer: No. Store algorithms are proprietary, and outcomes depend on competition, product quality, traffic, ratings, and changing policies.

faq.question: Can it translate store metadata?
faq.answer: It can generate localization drafts and market guidance. A native speaker should validate every translation before publication.

faq.question: Does it manage paid advertising?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on organic store discovery and conversion, not Apple Search Ads or Google Ads.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide current metadata, target keywords, competitor listings, reviews, ratings, conversion metrics, rankings, platform, locale, and business goals.
